summary: Live journey creates the coding task solely via real dashboard PTY keystrokes (n/repo/workflow/prompt) after asserting none pre-existed, and drives both PLANNING and ITERATING human approvals through the attached agent pane via _send_user_approval_while_gated, which fails if the task advances before the /advance input and asserts trigger=='advance'; the AST guard (_post_setup_direct_mutations) plus post-setup REST audit statically forbid any non-UI mutation, so a direct-mutation creation or approval is rejected.
